newsitem.title: USA: Grain dealers take 2 cents protection corn, 5c soy.
newsitem.headline: Grain dealers take 2 cents protection corn, 5c soy.

text.p: U.S. grain merchandisers in some eastern and western Corn Belt locations reported taking up to two cents a bushel protection on corn and up to five cents protection on soybeans Monday.
"We're taking protection and so are most other dealers out here," said a Nebraska merchandiser.
Cash dealers were taking protection in anticipation of a lower CBOT futures opening, they said.
Futures were called lower in response to good growing weather throughout the Midwest, sources said.
CBOT soybeans were seen opening three to five cents per bushel lower, and corn and wheat were expected to open one to two cents a bushel lower, traders said.
